items.en: This pit is full of moving drone-bases. Some structures might even create drone-bases.

The drones will destroy any structure in range immediatly. They will move freely over the map but prefer high ground, but not higher than 8. Try to get them trapped so you can nullify the drone-bases.

This is a testing simulator of a little game where you have to move the green walls in such a way that they will survive as long as possible. Arrow keys to move. The game will end in 10 minutes. Good luck!
What's up Creeper World Commanders? This is my very first map I made. This map was created in one of the first builds, it has been remastered for your pleasure. Enjoy, and thanks for playing!

I present to you: Warzone! This is the first map I made in one of the earliest builds of the game (way back in alpha!). Here it is, in its most raw form, aside from some added totems, this is the orginal map, just pure Creeper World Chaos! Also check out "War Zone" which is the updated version of this map for maximum madness!
The first mission from the old alpha versions that seemed impossible. Good luck!

Thanks to Virgil for the scripts and images (that i shamelessly "borrowed" from the meso map).
The idols have quite high energy demand, make sure you can run them before you hook them up!
go north or go east, it's up to you, but connecting point to point will give you what you need to win. (scripts from meso, thanks again Virgil, i love these powered idols!)
tek tip! packet speed is probably a good idea!
Welcome to the Alpha Sector!  Here you will find a collection of varied and assorted worlds. These maps were made throughout the development of the game by beta testers.
Some maps remain in their original form, others have been updated over time, yet others were updated at the end of game development by the beta testers.
You will find simple worlds, large worlds, super hard hards, testing worlds, puzzle words, maybe even impossible worlds.  Good luck on your journey!

Oh yeah... this mission!  Roam around my little dungeon and see what oddities you can find.  Use WASD or arrow keys to move, left mouse to fire (just hold it down).  Or you can click the right mouse button to turn on auto fire if your finger gets tired.

Take out emitters by getting near (a red range will appear around the Emitter), then pressing SPACE to drop a Personal Nullification Device.  It takes 5 seconds to arm, but you probably knew that already.
